Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

School & learning · Civic life: news, government & the law

nuclear adjective

also nuclear power, nuclear energy, nuclear weapon, nuclear bomb, atomic, atom

modern

Traupman 352: vīs nucleāris, nuclear power
Traupman 186: bomba nucleāris

nucleāris, nucleāre

adjective, third declension

Made on nucleus, the kernel of a nut or the stone of a fruit (Plin.), and so the hard inner part of anything. Lewis & Short marks the u of nucleus as common, so it is left unmarked.

Other words

  • atomicus, atomica, atomicum — atomic

    declension · also used · modern · Traupman 186: bomba atomica; M-O s.v. atomic: vīs atomica, atomic energy (Egger)

    Made on atomus (feminine), the atom of Democritus and Epicurus, which Cicero also calls corpora individua (Fin. 1.17).

Examples

  • vīs nucleāris

    nuclear powerTraupman 352

See also science, electric light.
